coverage: All twenty-three scenes in both original-en and modern-en: named cast, speaking and stage roles, the assumed names, and the legendary and classical figures named in the play.

entities.name: Sir John Falstaff
entities.body: A fat old knight lodging at the Garter, short of money.

snapshots.body: The old knight, escaped from Ford’s house in the fat woman of Brentford’s gown.

entities.name: Mistress Page
entities.body: A Windsor wife, called Meg; Master Page’s wife and Anne’s mother.

entities.name: Mistress Ford
entities.body: A Windsor wife, called Alice; Master Ford’s wife.

entities.name: Master Ford
entities.body: A Windsor householder, and a jealous husband.

snapshots.body: A Windsor householder, visiting Falstaff under the name Brook to draw him out.

entities.name: Master Page
entities.body: A Windsor householder, Anne’s and William’s father.

entities.name: Sir Hugh Evans
entities.body: A Welsh parson and schoolmaster in Windsor.

entities.name: Mistress Quickly
entities.body: Doctor Caius’s housekeeper, and go-between for everyone in the town.

entities.name: Justice Shallow
entities.body: A country justice, come to Windsor with a grievance against Falstaff.

entities.name: Abraham Slender
entities.body: Shallow’s foolish young cousin, and a suitor for Anne Page.

entities.name: Doctor Caius
entities.body: A French physician of Windsor, and a suitor for Anne Page.

entities.name: The Host of the Garter
entities.body: The landlord of the Garter Inn.

entities.name: Pistol
entities.body: One of Falstaff’s followers.

entities.name: Peter Simple
entities.body: Slender’s servant.

entities.name: Anne Page
entities.body: Master Page’s daughter, sought by three suitors.

snapshots.body: Master Page’s daughter, married to Fenton at the church by Eton.

entities.name: Fenton
entities.body: A young gentleman in love with Anne Page.

snapshots.body: The young gentleman who has married Anne Page.

entities.name: Bardolph
entities.body: One of Falstaff’s followers, taken on as a drawer at the Garter.

entities.name: Nym
entities.body: One of Falstaff’s followers.

entities.name: William Page
entities.body: Master Page’s young son, taken through his Latin by Sir Hugh.

entities.name: John Rugby
entities.body: Doctor Caius’s servant.

entities.name: Robin
entities.body: Falstaff’s page, lent to Mistress Page.

entities.name: The First Servant
entities.body: One of Ford’s servants, who carries the buck-basket.

entities.name: The Second Servant
entities.body: One of Ford’s servants, who carries the buck-basket.

entities.name: The servant
entities.body: A servant in Master Page’s house.

entities.name: The servants
entities.body: Ford’s servants, who carry the buck-basket to Datchet Mead.

entities.name: The fairies
entities.body: The children and neighbours dressed as fairies at Herne’s oak.

entities.name: Herne the Hunter
entities.body: The keeper of Windsor legend, said to walk the forest with great ragg’d horns.

entities.name: The fat woman of Brentford
entities.body: A wise woman of Brentford whom Ford has forbidden his house; Falstaff escapes in her gown.

entities.name: Mother Prat
entities.body: The name Mistress Ford gives the fat woman’s gown when Falstaff is wearing it.

entities.name: Master Thomas Page
entities.body: Anne Page’s father under his given name, as Sir Hugh states it.

entities.name: George
entities.body: Master Page under his given name, as his wife uses it.

entities.name: Frank
entities.body: Master Ford under his given name.

entities.name: Sackerson
entities.body: The bear Slender boasts of having led about.

entities.name: The witch of Brentford
entities.body: The woman Ford believes he is beating, being Falstaff in her gown.

entities.name: Jove
entities.body: The king of the gods, who took a bull’s shape for Europa and a swan’s for Leda.

entities.name: Europa
entities.body: The woman Jove carried off in the shape of a bull.

entities.name: Leda
entities.body: The woman Jove came to in the shape of a swan.

entities.name: Actaeon
entities.body: The hunter turned to a stag, a byword here for the horned cuckold.

entities.name: Alice Shortcake
entities.body: A Windsor woman Slender lent his Book of Riddles to.

entities.name: Ringwood
entities.body: One of Actaeon’s hounds, in Pistol’s warning to Ford.

entities.name: Hercules
entities.body: The strongest of the Greek heroes.

entities.name: Pandarus
entities.body: The go-between of the Troy story, in Pistol’s refusal.

entities.name: Hobgoblin
entities.body: The goblin of country belief, one of the parts in the fairy masque.

entities.name: Mephostophilus
entities.body: The devil of the Faustus play, in Pistol’s abuse of Simple.

entities.name: Lucifer
entities.body: The chief of the fallen angels.

entities.name: Barbason
entities.body: A demon whose name Ford will not answer to.

entities.name: Machiavel
entities.body: The byword for cunning statecraft the Host claims for himself.

entities.name: Cataian
entities.body: A Cathayan, meaning a sharper; Page’s word for a man he will not believe.
